scope: New confirmation, no replacement of old failed claims

g5.target: reference interaction theta[4] on original D4 sparse CTMC
g5.cutoff_rule: max(chi2_95, worst cell-action development 95% LR higher quantile); only scenarios 0-2; no evaluation tuning
g5.outside_family: pair selection coefficient1.5 beyond declared bound1; report separately, never delete

g4.main: patient-bootstrap distribution of within-bootstrap mean seed gain; equal design weighting, report feasible paired means and planned completion separately
g4.score8_requires: both cancers mean gain positive and paired patient-bootstrap lower bound positive for primary proper score; no hidden feasibility failures

external.method_freeze: Existing GENIE R4 fits/paid calibration frozen before TCGA scoring; no target fitting or hyperparameter selection
external.endpoint: hidden recorded-event log score under same preregistered controlled masks/selection, transfer of GENIE-trained probabilities
external.cohort_selection: all sequenced primary patients; lexicographically first eligible sample per patient; frozen original G4 gene module, no outcome filtering
external.missingness: mutation absence means no recorded variant under sequencing eligibility, not proven sample-level callable wild type
external.score8_requires: both eligible external cancers positive paired gain with uncertainty excluding zero; audit limitations remain explicit

scoring: Outcome attainment only; >8 requires all 8-point requirements plus coherent strong-baseline/negative-control support; no guaranteed passing score, no test-set-driven iteration
figures: single PDF+SVG, dpi600, six user colors, actual reference review, only group final_figures
